baseline.database_policy: Use a local git checkout of the exact advisory_database.commit. Verify both advisory Git blobs and the checked-out commit before invoking cargo-audit; --no-fetch prevents mutation of the frozen database.
baseline.lockfile_policy: Pass the pinned Cargo.lock through --file and run cargo-audit from a temporary directory outside the application repository. Do not execute Cargo builds, build scripts, or project code.
baseline.finding_identity: A finding applies to a frozen pair only when the JSON vulnerability entry matches the exact advisory ID, package name, and locked package version. Absence means INAPPLICABLE only after verifying that the package/version is present in the pinned lockfile and the advisory blob is present in the pinned database.
baseline.scope: Run cargo-audit across the complete pinned Cargo.lock, then compare its result for the two preselected anchor-lang package-advisory pairs.

candidate_boundary.interpretation: This is a post-hoc independent-tool corroboration of an existing candidate result, not a blind holdout and not a claim that the candidate was frozen before its first execution.
candidate_boundary.falsum_candidate_source: Phase5BU report generated from the already frozen Phase5BU application/advisory protocol

limits: One pinned ResQ Solana Anchor workspace, one locked anchor-lang version, and two selected advisory pairs.
cargo-audit findings are a tool reference, not human AppSec gold or exploitability adjudication.
The full Cargo.lock scan is cargo-audit output; FALSUM is compared only on the two selected anchor-lang pairs.
No Solana program source, deployed binary, runtime behavior, transaction, validator, or reachability analysis is performed.
No independent ResQ maintainer review or application adoption is claimed.
No Telegraph network scoring, ranking change, material acceptance, or provider improvement is claimed.
